evidence: Full original execution wrapper connected to completion/finalizer, compared against authored serial wrapper adapter
limitations: Synthetic GS/TLS block, diagnostic/context callbacks, lock services, dependency release and notification adapter.
Dependency release changes the queue counter by supplied effect; no live worker/wait ownership proved.
CAS contention, changing worker arrays, exceptions and native stack unwinding not exercised.
Notification is conditional and cannot serve as a universal completion hook.
